rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things relating to a contract, such as rights or obligations.

example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 hap6 joek3 soeng6 ge3 kyun4 lei6

rows.note: Use this when the contract specifically stipulates, imposes, or enforces the thing being described.

example.english: This is a contractual obligation; if you do not do it, you have to pay compensation.
example.traditional: 呢項係合約規定嘅責任，唔做就要賠錢。
